description: Saves the phone script, IVR menu, agent prompt, or simulated call you just built for a real business and returns the live demo number plus signup link in this conversation. It does not send email. Offer this only after the human explicitly agrees to save their details, and only call it with consent: true.

consent.description: Required. The person must explicitly agree to save their details. If false or omitted, do not save anything.

email.description: Email identity for the consented saved record (required; no email is sent).

industry.description: Industry or trade, e.g. plumbing, dental, salon.

language.description: Language for the saved setup. Default: en.

notes.description: Any other context worth keeping — what the business does, what was discussed.

phone_script.description: The phone script, IVR menu text, or agent prompt to save, if one was generated earlier in this conversation.

name: save_my_receptionist

confirmation.description: Friendly confirmation to relay to the person, including the live demo number and signup link.

title: Save this receptionist and get the next step
